title: Blending & Production Specialist — Holiday w/ long term Inventory Support Growth Path em simão dias (SE)
description:
Blending & Production Specialist - Holiday w Long term Inventory Support Growth Path

Turn your love of flavor, detail, and hands-on work into a job where precision actually matters.

The Spice & Tea Exchange is a sensory specialty retail shop filled with spices, teas, sugars, salts, blends, gifts, recipes, and discovery. Guests see the beautiful shelves, smell the spices, taste the teas, and find products they love — but a lot of that magic starts behind the scenes. We are looking for careful, reliable, detail-oriented support for our Annapolis holiday season. This role helps us blend, package, label, stock, organize, and prepare products so the store is accurate, full, beautiful, and guest‑ready during our busiest time of year. This is not a “stand behind the register and wait” kind of retail job. It is also not a “make it up as you go” production job. This role is best for someone who likes recipes, checklists, clean workspaces, repetition, accuracy, and the satisfaction of finishing work the right way. Some candidates may be newer and ready to learn step by step. Others may bring experience in food prep, production, inventory, stocking, labeling, quality control, receiving, counting, or team training. Both types may fit here. What matters most is care, reliability, accuracy, coachability, and follow‑through.

What you’ll do

  • Blend spices, teas, sugars, salts, and other products according to recipes and procedures.
  • Weigh, scoop, fill, seal, label, and organize products accurately.
  • Restock shelves, jars, bins, and displays so the store stays full and guest‑ready.
  • Help prepare seasonal and holiday products, gifts, and high‑demand items.
  • Follow production checklists, batch instructions, cleanliness standards, and store procedures.
  • Keep production areas and backstock clean, orderly, food‑safe, and efficient.
  • Check labels, weights, ingredients, packaging, quantities, and product presentation for accuracy.
  • Notice when products are low, mislabeled, misplaced, damaged, overstocked, or out of place.
  • Communicate clearly when supplies, labels, ingredients, packaging, counts, or instructions are missing or unclear.
  • Support the behind‑the‑scenes quality that makes the store feel abundant, beautiful, and trustworthy.

You may be a great fit if you…

  • Like hands‑on work and take pride in doing things correctly.
  • Are careful with details, labels, numbers, recipes, counts, and instructions.
  • Enjoy repetition, routine, organization, and visible progress.
  • Can follow a checklist without treating it as optional.
  • Notice when something is messy, missing, mislabeled, miscounted, or incomplete.
  • Prefer steady, focused work over constant social interaction.
  • Are coachable and willing to learn the right way to do things.
  • Can work carefully without moving so slowly that work does not get done.
  • Understand that “close enough” is not good enough when product quality, inventory accuracy, and customer trust are involved.

This role has room to grow

This role starts with hands‑on blending, production, stocking, labeling, and holiday preparation.

For the right person, it may grow toward senior production responsibility, inventory support, receiving support, backstock organization, cycle counts, product availability tracking, operations support, keyholder responsibility, or broader store leadership over time. We are especially interested in candidates who enjoy both doing the work carefully and helping the store stay organized and accurate.

Requirements

  • Reliable attendance and punctuality, especially during holiday preparation and peak selling periods.
  • Comfort standing, moving, reaching, scooping, weighing, filling, labeling, stocking, organizing, and cleaning during shifts.
  • Ability to assist with unpacking, stocking, and moving items, generally up to 15–25 lbs.
  • Willingness to follow recipes, checklists, production standards, inventory procedures, and cleanliness expectations.
  • Strong attention to detail and respect for accuracy.
  • Comfort with repetitive hands‑on work.
  • Ability to receive feedback and adjust quickly.
  • Ability to ask questions when something is unclear rather than guessing.
  • Weekend, holiday, seasonal, or peak‑period availability may be required based on business needs.
  • Prior experience in food prep, baking, production, packing, labeling, stocking, receiving, inventory, merchandising, retail operations, or quality‑control work is helpful but not required.
  • Age 18+ preferred for broader responsibility, equipment use, closing support, and growth opportunities.

Compensation & growth

Compensation varies by experience, availability, and role fit. Candidates may be considered for junior or senior production responsibility based on demonstrated accuracy, reliability, independence, prior experience, and ability to support quality standards. Strong performers may be considered for additional responsibility or future growth opportunities in production, inventory support, operations, keyholding, or store leadership based on performance, availability, and business needs.

Perks & benefits

  • Hands‑on culinary discovery — learn, blend, taste, organize, and explore.
  • Work with spices, teas, sugars, salts, blends, gifts, and sensory products.
  • Help prepare the store for a busy, festive holiday season.
  • Satisfying behind‑the‑scenes work where details matter.
  • Room to grow in production, inventory, operations, and leadership.
  • Team discounts + free monthly products.
  • A workplace that smells better than most jobs.

Who we are

The Spice & Tea Exchange is a specialty retail shop bursting with flavor, warmth, and welcoming energy. We help guests explore the magic of taste — whether they are cooking dinner, building a gift, restocking a favorite tea, or discovering something completely new.

We believe retail can still feel human, personal, and fun. Our best team members do more than complete tasks. They create moments of trust, discovery, quality, and care — whether they are helping a guest directly or making sure every product behind the experience is accurate, beautiful, stocked, and ready.

Company Culture Card:

Ready to help create the magic behind the shelves?

If you are careful, reliable, coachable, detail-oriented, and interested in hands‑on production work with spices and teas, we’d love to meet you.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Elaborar, desenvolver e revisar modelos digitais de engenharia utilizando a metodologia BIM (Building Information Modeling), abrangendo projetos de telecomunicações, sistemas elétricos, infraestrutura e instalações industriais. Desenvolver modelos tridimensionais, documentação técnica, compatibilização entre disciplinas e extração de quantitativos, garantindo conformidade com normas técnicas, padrões BIM da empresa e requisitos do cliente.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Levantamento e Modelagem: Realizar levantamento técnico em campo e desenvolver modelos BIM para telecomunicações, infraestrutura, instalações elétricas e sistemas auxiliares.
  • Documentação Executiva: Elaborar plantas, cortes, elevações, detalhes construtivos, layouts, diagramas e vistas extraídas diretamente dos modelos BIM.
  • Bibliotecas e Famílias: Elaborar famílias, componentes e bibliotecas paramétricas quando necessário.
  • Compatibilização e Clash Detection: Compatibilizar disciplinas (Arquitetura, Civil, Elétrica, Mecânica, Telecomunicações) e detectar interferências via Clash Detection, propondo soluções técnicas.
  • Listas e Quantitativos: Extrair listas de materiais e quantitativos dos modelos, incluindo listas de materiais de projetos de painéis de todas as disciplinas.
  • Gestão e Padrões BIM: Garantir conformidade com o Plano de Execução BIM (BEP), participar de reuniões de coordenação, controlar revisões e apoiar padrões e templates internos.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Formação Mínima:

  • Formação Técnica em Telecomunicações, Redes de Computadores, Elétrica, Eletrônica, Eletrotécnica ou áreas correlatas

Formação Desejável:

  • Cursando Ensino Superior em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Telecomunicações ou áreas correlatas

Conhecimentos técnicos:

  • Leitura de diagramas elétricos/telecom, desenvolvimento de famílias paramétricas, extração de quantitativos e normas ABNT aplicáveis

Softwares Obrigatórios:

  • Autodesk Revit (Avançado), Autodesk AutoCAD 2D/3D (Avançado), Autodesk Navisworks Manage, Autodesk BIM Collaborate Pro / ACC e Microsoft Office.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada na área em projetos de engenharia, modelos BIM multidisciplinares, compatibilização e emissão de documentação técnica extraída dos modelos.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimentos em Civil 3D, InfraWorks, OpenBuildings, MicroStation, Solibri, Dynamo, IFC/OpenBIM, ISO 19650 e CDE.
